title: Infer3D: Inverse Generative Modeling Enables Robust 3D Reconstruction
abstract: arXiv:2611.25061v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Humans can understand the 3D structure of scenes even from highly unfamiliar or extreme viewpoints. Cognitive science suggests this generalization stems from a top-down generative inference strategy. In contrast, state-of-the-art 3D reconstruction neural networks typically rely on amortized, feedforward inference. While fast, this pattern-matching approach degrades when faced with out-of-distribution (OOD) scene conditions unseen during training. Inspired by the generative nature of human vision, we propose Infer3D, an inverse generative modeling framework that recovers the latent variables of a generative model to best match the monocular input. To prevent degenerate flat outputs, we couple the generative image prior with a frozen 3D lifting network that constrains the optimization space to a valid, multi-view-consistent 3D manifold. translated_title: Infer3D：逆向生成建模实现鲁棒的3D重建
translated_abstract: 即使从高度陌生或极端的视角，人类也能理解场景的3D结构。认知科学表明，这种泛化能力源于一种自顶向下的生成式推理策略。相比之下，最先进的3D重建神经网络通常依赖摊销式前馈推理。这种方法虽然快速，但在面对训练中未见过的分布外（OOD）场景条件时会性能退化。受人类视觉生成特性的启发，我们提出了Infer3D，这是一个逆向生成建模框架，通过恢复生成模型的潜变量来最佳匹配单目输入。为防止退化的平坦输出，我们将生成式图像先验与一个冻结的3D提升网络耦合，将优化空间约束在有效的、多视角一致的3D流形上。在各种受控的合成和真实世界任务中，Infer3D展现出了卓越的OOD重建能力。
tldr: 该论文提出Infer3D逆向生成建模框架，通过恢复生成模型的潜变量并结合冻结的3D提升网络约束优化空间，使单目3D重建在分布外场景条件下依然保持鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Infer3D, an inverse generative modeling framework that recovers latent variables of a generative model coupled with a frozen 3D lifting network, enabling robust monocular 3D reconstruction under out-of-distribution scene conditions.
